WATERTIGHTNESS.scope: reinforced concrete roofs/floors within standard scope

STRUCTURAL_LOADS.hard_gate: Roof structure and cladding/attachments must be designed for applicable loads/actions, including wind design context.

CLIMATE_DATA.hard_gate: Use local/climatic data for design; do not infer from traditional qi terms.

LIGHTNING.hard_gate: Lightning protection assessment/design where applicable overrides visual/Feng Shui preferences.

SOLAR_REFLECTIVE_COATING.note: Standard applies to high-solar-reflectance roof paint; it is not a substitute for the waterproofing system.

DOWNSTREAM_STORMWATER.rule: Roof runoff must ultimately connect to a safe/lawful stormwater strategy.
